meta.source: INFORM Risk Mid 2026 (v0.7.3) - JRC / European Commission
meta.description: File 1 - SPECIFIC indicators: only the hazard/exposure indicators that unambiguously belong to a single disaster type (plus that disaster's own INFORM hazard component). No cross-cutting vulnerability or coping-capacity indicators here. Disasters with no dedicated INFORM hazard layer have an empty list.

type_values.raw: raw hazard/exposure indicator from the data sheet
type_values.raw_proxy: raw indicator used as a proxy (no dedicated INFORM layer for this hazard)
type_values.aggregated: computed INFORM component/dimension score (unit: INFORM score 0-10)

indicators.name: Physical exposure to extensive earthquake (absolute)
indicators.description: The indicator is based on the estimated number of people exposed to earthquakes of Modified Mercalli Intensity higher than MMI 6 per year. It results from the combination of the hazard zones and the total population living in the spatial unit. It thus indicates the expected number of people exposed in the hazard zone in one year.
indicators.inform_group: Hazards & Exposure > Natural > Earthquake > Earthquake Extensive (absolute)

indicators.description: The indicator is based on the estimated number of people exposed to earthquakes of Modified Mercalli Intensity higher than MMI 6 per year. indicators.name: Agriculture drought probability
indicators.description: The indicator is based on the FAO Agriculture Stress Index (ASI) that highlights anomalous vegetation growth and potential drought in arable land. It is defined as the annual probability to have more than 30% of agriculture area affected by drought.
indicators.inform_group: Hazards & Exposure > Natural > Drought

indicators.inform_group: Hazards & Exposure > Natural > Drought > Drought (absolute)

indicators.name: People affected by droughts (relative)
indicators.description: The indicator shows the percentage of the average annual affected population per country by droughts on the period from 1990 to 2013.

indicators.name: Population exposed to CCHF
indicators.description: These maps use reported geographic information on index cases of outbreaks and viral detection in animals related to a number of environmental factors thought to influence the distribution of these pathogens using species distribution models in order to build an environmental profile that best characterizes possible pathogen presence.
indicators.inform_group: Hazards & Exposure > Natural > Epidemic > Zoonoses

indicators.name: Number of live animals per capita
indicators.description: Number of live animals (cattle and buffaloes, poultry birds, and sheep and goats) in each coutry divided by the total population of the country.
indicators.inform_group: Hazards & Exposure > Natural > Epidemic > Zoonoses

indicators.name: Populations at risk of malaria
indicators.description:
The WHO estimates annual population at risk of malaria based on the United Nations population, times the proportion of the population at risk
at baseline.
indicators.inform_group: Hazards & Exposure > Natural > Epidemic > Vector borne

indicators.name: Population exposed to Zika
indicators.description: The indicator is based on the estimated number of people potentially exposed to Zika virus (ZIKV). To calculate the number of people located in an area that is at any level of risk for ZIKV transmission, a global ZIKV environmental suitability map was combined with fine-scale global population map (GHS-POP).
indicators.inform_group: Hazards & Exposure > Natural > Epidemic > Vector borne

indicators.name: Population at Risk to Aedes
indicators.description: The indicator is based on the estimated number of people potentially exposed to Aedes mosquites. To calculate the number of people located in an area that is suitable for Aedes mosquites, a global Aedes environmental suitability map was combined with fine-scale global population map (GHS-POP).
indicators.inform_group: Hazards & Exposure > Natural > Epidemic > Vector borne

indicators.inform_group: Hazards & Exposure > Natural > Epidemic > Vector borne

indicators.name: Population exposed to virus (waterborne)
indicators.description: Population exposed to waterborne virus; exposure factor for water/food-borne epidemics.
indicators.inform_group: Hazards & Exposure > Natural > Epidemic > Water and Food borne

indicators.name: IHR capacity score: Food safety
indicators.description: The percentage of the average of all indicators, which reflect the level of performance or achievement of Core Capacity 4. Food Safety Each capacity has one to three indicators. Each indicator is based on five cumulative levels, with attributes (one of a set of specific elements or characteristics that reflect the level of performance or achievement of a specific indicator) for annual reporting.
indicators.inform_group: Hazards & Exposure > Natural > Epidemic > Water and Food borne

indicators.name: People with basic handwashing facilities including soap and water (% of population)
indicators.description: The percentage of people living in households that have a handwashing facility with soap and water available on the premises. Handwashing facilities may be fixed or mobile and include a sink with tap water, buckets with taps, tippy-taps, and jugs or basins designated for handwashing. Soap includes bar soap, liquid soap, powder detergent, and soapy water but does not include ash, soil, sand or other handwashing agents.
indicators.inform_group: Hazards & Exposure > Natural > Epidemic > Water and Food borne

indicators.name: People practicing open defecation (% of population)
indicators.description: People practicing open defecation refers to the percentage of the population defecating in the open, such as in fields, forest, bushes, open bodies of water, on beaches, in other open spaces or disposed of with solid waste.
indicators.inform_group: Hazards & Exposure > Natural > Epidemic > P2P / Water and Food borne

indicators.name: INFORM Zoonoses exposure sub-component
indicators.description: Aggregated exposure to zoonotic diseases (CCHF, EVD, Lassa, MVD, livestock).

indicators.name: INFORM Vector-borne exposure sub-component
indicators.description: Aggregated exposure to vector-borne diseases (malaria, Zika, Aedes, dengue).

indicators.name: INFORM Water/food-borne exposure sub-component
indicators.description: Aggregated exposure to water- and food-borne transmission factors.

indicators.name: INFORM Epidemic hazard component
indicators.description: Aggregated physical-exposure score for epidemics.

indicators.name: Current Conflict Intensity
indicators.description: To assess the intensity of ongoing conflicts around the globe, we use Ongoing Domestic and International Conflict scores from the Global peace Index. The index uses six statistical indicators to investigate the extent to which countries are involved in internal and external conflicts, as well as their role and duration of involvement in conflicts.
indicators.inform_group: Hazards & Exposure > Human > Conflict Risk > Current Conflict Intensity

indicators.name: Projected Conflict Probability
indicators.description: The Global Conflict Risk Index (GCRI) estimates the risk of internal conflict at the country level within the next 4 years. INFORM Risk uses the GCRI probability estimates for the “any conflict” category, which includes the sub-categories “state-based conflict”, “non-state conflict”, and “one-sided violence”.
indicators.inform_group: Hazards & Exposure > Human > Conflict Risk > Projected Conflict Probability

indicators.name: INFORM Conflict risk component
indicators.description: Aggregated score: current conflict intensity + projected conflict probability.
